ds.name: GOV.UK Design System
ds.description: GOV.UK styles, components and patterns: GDS Transport, blue identity, green service buttons and yellow keyboard focus. Sampled homepage controls have square corners; the documented Tag has a 1px radius.

tokens.note: Homepage census and six measured product controls. Official service styles retained from opened documentation and served CSS are identified separately in the body. The cookie banner remained open; the probe did not recognise Reject additional cookies.
